title: Kiosks and open air cafes
previewText: Kiosks and open air cafes may be placed within an existing plaza, residential plaza or urban plaza upon certification by the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission, pursuant to Section 37-73 (Kiosks and Open Air Cafes).
